{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: No correction needed for batch B
# According to unit conversion: 1 µg/L = 1 ng/mL
# So batch-B values are already in ng/mL
# Therefore, use biomarker_final as-is
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Round to one decimal place for reporting
rounded_mean = round(mean_biomarker_final, 1)

# Print the rounded value
print(rounded_mean)"}
